high_level_description: The image depicts US Vice President Kamala Harris speaking at Howard University in Washington, DC, on November 6, 2024. The setting is formal and official, with the backdrop featuring multiple American flags arranged symmetrically behind her. The flags are displayed vertically, with their stars and stripes clearly visible. Kamala Harris is standing behind a podium adorned with the seal of the President of the United States. She is dressed in a dark-colored suit and appears to be mid-speech, gesturing with her right hand raised.
